captions.detailed: This 3D model is a single half of a parametric magnetic bag clip, designed with a curved, U-shaped body. The inner curve of the U-shape is rounded to accommodate folded bag material, while the outer profile is smooth and contoured. The two ends of the U-shape feature cylindrical hinge or magnet-holding bosses with vertical boreholes. One side has a single central slot cut out of the boss, while the opposite side has top and bottom slots, allowing two identical printed halves to interlock together.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric half-clip for a magnetic bag closure in OpenSCAD. The script should allow customization of the opening length and width, wall thickness, magnet diameter, magnet height, and the gap between interlocking hinge parts, generating a single self-mating piece.
captions.factory: The code uses a helper module 'roundRect' which creates a rounded rectangle by applying 'hull' to four corner cylinders. In the 'makeClip' module, the main body is formed by subtracting a smaller 'roundRect' from a larger one, and then cutting it in half with a 'cube'. Hinge cylinders are added at both ends using a 'for' loop, which are then bored out for magnets. Finally, horizontal slots are subtracted using cubes on the left and right ends at different Z heights to create the interlocking self-mating hinge mechanism.
